name: Lion's Pride Inn
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn, travelers rest and find work just south of Stormwind. Innkeeper Farley welcomes them to Goldshire's gathering place in Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: Heart of Goldshire
sections.body: Goldshire's crossroads bring travelers to the Lion's Pride Inn. Innkeeper Farley keeps the old motto: “Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold.” Hearths, strong drinks, and rooms welcome weary travelers from Northshire. The roads link Stormwind with Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood, so town marshals, local crafters, and seasoned trainers gather here to share news and hire passing mercenaries.

faq.q: Who owns and runs the Lion's Pride Inn?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Farley runs the Lion's Pride Inn and welcomes weary travelers with its motto: “Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold.”

faq.q: What services are available inside the inn?
faq.answer: The inn offers food, drink, and lodging. Class trainers, visiting merchants, and locals seeking help with Elwynn Forest's gnoll, kobold, and bandit troubles can also be found there.

faq.q: Why is the inn such a central hub in Elwynn?
faq.answer: The Lion's Pride Inn is the chief rest stop for travelers between Stormwind, Westfall, and the Redridge Mountains. It stands at Goldshire's crossroads just south of Stormwind, and young travelers from Northshire Valley reach it as their first major gathering place.

faq.q: What is the motto of the Lion's Pride Inn?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Farley gives the Lion's Pride Inn's motto as “Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold.”

angles.text: For humans leaving Northshire Abbey, the Lion's Pride Inn offers a first glimpse of the kingdom's wider life and the troubles beyond the monastery walls.
As the main inn outside Stormwind's gates, the Lion's Pride Inn gives Alliance travelers a place to coordinate patrols and trade across the heartlands.
